observed_behavior: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.7 requires a keyboard-operable user interface to provide a mode of operation in which its keyboard focus indicator is visible.
context: WCAG 2.2 W3C Recommendation, 12 December 2024; exact criterion 2.4.7 Focus Visible; focused W07 B1 K3 normative extraction. Level AA; requirement and associated W3C notes/conditions only.
limitations: Requires a mode with visible keyboard focus; the SC does not impose the numerical indicator size/contrast conditions found in separate WCAG 2.4.13 Focus Appearance (Level AAA).
Does not require one particular outline style, color, or design-system component.
Focus-indicator visibility was read from normative text, not measured or tested in a browser.
source_version_context: WCAG 2.2 W3C Recommendation, 12 December 2024; immutable dated Recommendation URL https://www.w3.org/TR/2024/REC-WCAG22-20241212/; direct section #focus-visible; retrieval 2026-10-08
notes: Normative-text attribution only; not an application finding, accepted Forge pattern, browser test or assistive-technology result.
